webui.guide:
Memora Management Interface

Please access via AstrBot official WebUI:
• Open AstrBot Dashboard
• Go to Plugins -> Memora -> Pages -> dashboard

Tips:
• Plugin page reuses AstrBot login state, no extra login needed
• Requires AstrBot >= 4.24.2

Available in interface:
• Memory editing and management
• Visual statistics and analysis
• Graph browsing and recall debugging
• Data migration and index maintenance

help.text:
Memora User Guide

Core commands:
/memora status              View system status
/memora search <keyword> [count]  Search memories (default 5)
/memora forget <ID>          Delete specified memory
/memora rebuild-index       Rebuild index (fix inconsistency)
/memora rebuild-graph       Rebuild graph memory index (backfill old data)
/memora webui               Show WebUI management interface entry
/memora summarize           Immediately trigger memory summarization for current session
/memora reset               Reset current session memory context
/memora cleanup [preview|exec] Clean up memory injection fragments in historical messages (default preview)
/memora help                Show this help

Usage tips:
• Use search command for daily queries
• For complex management, go to Plugins -> Memora -> Pages -> dashboard in AstrBot Dashboard
• Memories are automatically saved from conversations
• Use forget to delete sensitive information
• Execute rebuild-index when index is inconsistent
• After enabling graph memory, execute rebuild-graph to backfill old data
• After plugin update, execute cleanup to clean old data

cleanup command examples:
  /memora cleanup          # Preview mode, shows statistics only
  /memora cleanup preview  # Same as above
  /memora cleanup exec     # Perform actual cleanup

More info: https://github.com/INSide-734/astrbot_plugin_memora
